learning_outcomes.text: Outlines the structure of internal combustion engines.
Compares different engine types and calculates engine performance parameters.
Explains the combustion process in engines.
Explains exhaust emissions and their formation mechanism in engines.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts related to engines and engine operating principles
Ideal cycles of internal combustion engines
Problem solving related to ideal cycles of internal combustion engines
Fuel-air cycles of internal combustion engines
Real cycles of internal combustion engines
Fuels used in engines, their production and properties
Combustion stoichiometry and combustion in engines
Combustion in diesel engines and diesel knock
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
bibliography: TAYLOR, ´The Internal Combustion Engines in Theory & Practice´, M.I.I. Press Massachusetts, Fourth Printing, 1980.
